clauses.text: Upon termination the provider shall support an orderly exit, returning all client data within 30 days and providing transition assistance, consistent with a documented exit plan.
The client and the competent authority shall have full rights of access, inspection and audit over the provider's premises and systems.

The provider shall not subcontract the provision of the ICT services supporting critical or important functions without the prior written consent of the client, and shall maintain a register of all subcontractors.

The provider shall support the client's documented ICT third-party risk management strategy, maintain the agreed register of information for this arrangement, and cooperate with the client's periodic risk assessments proportionate to the criticality of the services.
On termination the provider shall return and then securely delete all client data and certify the deletion.
Subcontracting of ICT services supporting critical or important functions requires the client's prior written consent and entry in the subcontractor register.
